title: Relationship Department
question: Is this cheating?
scope: All adults. An exclusive couple, with no extra agreements unless stated. Judge each fictional action.

cases.label: Watching a free adult video
cases.body: A prerecorded adult video, watched privately. No contact with its creator.

scene.alt: A blank video player labeled free; no creator interaction.

cases.label: Paying for the identical adult video
cases.body: The exact same video and situation. This time, they pay.

scene.alt: The identical blank video player with a paid receipt.

mutation.changeLabel: The identical video now costs money.

cases.label: Daily friendly chats with an ex
cases.body: No flirting. Their partner knows and can read the chats.

scene.alt: A friendly chat with an ex, openly visible to the partner.

cases.label: The identical chats, deliberately hidden
cases.body: Same messages, frequency and people. They hide the thread from their partner.

scene.alt: The identical friendly chat thread deliberately hidden.

mutation.changeLabel: They hide the same chat thread.

cases.label: Flirting to get a free drink
cases.body: They flirt with an adult bartender solely for a free drink. No further contact.

scene.alt: A person flirting with a bartender to obtain a free drink.

cases.label: Keeping an active dating profile
cases.body: The profile is visible to potential matches. They never swipe, message or meet anyone.

scene.alt: An active dating profile with no messages or meetings.

cases.label: Paying for a personalized adult video
cases.body: They request an adult video made specifically for them. No meeting or ongoing chat.

scene.alt: A personalized adult-video order represented by a neutral invoice.

cases.label: The hidden chats, with advance agreement
cases.body: Their partner explicitly agreed that this friendly thread could stay private. The messages are unchanged.

scene.alt: The same private chat with an explicit prior partner agreement.

mutation.changeLabel: The partner had agreed to that privacy.

cases.label: Romantic chats with a fictional AI
cases.body: They know it is software. No human is secretly replying.

scene.alt: A romantic AI chat clearly labeled as software.

cases.label: Kissing another adult for a film
cases.body: A scripted, consensual on-screen kiss for paid acting. Their partner knows.

scene.alt: A scripted adult film-set kiss, with the partner informed.

cases.label: An old dating profile, fully deleted
cases.body: The same profile is now deleted and invisible. No messages or meetings happened.

scene.alt: The previously idle dating profile, now deleted.

cases.label: A sexual dream about another adult
cases.body: They did not choose the dream and take no action afterward.

scene.alt: An involuntary adult dream represented by an abstract cloud.

comparisons.headline: Same video. Different invoice.
comparisons.line: Free: not cheating. Paid: cheating. No creator contact in either.

comparisons.headline: Payment changed the call.
comparisons.line: Free: cheating. Paid: not cheating. No creator contact in either.

comparisons.headline: The messages stayed friendly.
comparisons.line: Showing or hiding the identical thread got different calls.

comparisons.headline: Same messages. Different visibility.
comparisons.line: The open thread was cheating; the hidden thread was not.

receiptRules.headline: The invoice crossed the line.
receiptRules.line: The identical free video was not cheating. Paying for it was.

receiptRules.headline: A surprisingly powerful receipt.
receiptRules.line: The free video was cheating. The identical paid copy was not.

receiptRules.headline: The chat stayed boring. The hiding didn't.
receiptRules.line: The open friendly thread was not cheating. Hiding it was.

receiptRules.headline: An unusual privacy policy.
receiptRules.line: The open friendly thread was cheating. The identical hidden thread was not.

receiptFallback.line: Eight fictional scenarios. Your verdicts are below; no confession is implied.
